PROVINCE NO. 1. A WHOLE WORLD OF ITS OWN.

The first light.
A different Nepal.

Follow the landscape from the great Himalayan horizons to tea-covered hills and the bird-rich plains. Koshi asks you to look beyond the summit—and stay for everything in between.

Meet the people, sacred places and everyday stories of eastern Nepal. Start with a feeling. Find a place. Make the journey your own.

Formerly Province No. 1 · Borders China to the north and India to the east and south.
